digest.component_or_area: jira data center reconciliation harness and mutation suite
propositions: The epic's headline AC—an issue created in DC appears locally after inbound pass, and a local edit appears in DC after outbound pass—is proven live over a real scrubbed copy of the production store, not an empty one.

The reconciler must be prevented from writing to production Jira keys through dual isolation: a separate git repo with no remotes (primary mechanism) plus REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off (secondary layer), and the store copy must have all .bridge_state* artifacts and bindings scrubbed to remove production Jira references.

A filtered pass over a scrubbed store produces exactly zero deletion mutations and zero outbound update mutations, proving the scrub is complete and the binding removal prevents spurious remote writes.

All 28-cell mutation table (14 inbound, 14 outbound) round-trips must be asserted individually against named oracles, with the two exceptions that set_parent's epic case raises NotImplementedError (asserted directly on transport) and idempotence is a separate per-direction assertion to avoid false reds from index lag.

Multi-page pagination is exercised by observing the effective server page size, seeding 2*observed+1 issues in the harness, and asserting full recovery of all seeded keys from an unfiltered dry-run plan, proving the fetch does not truncate silently.

Four product defects were found and fixed separately: phantom outbound updates from snapshot-differ field drift (727f), snapshot-absent keys planned as creates (d103), DC outbound status field edit instead of transition (d067), and a setup oracle precondition for inbound assignee identity minting that must exclude pre-existing mappings from the scrubbed store copy.
